elaine: Hey team — PR #4825 is blocked by the pre-commit/typecheck gate in CI. Failing on `mypy` and `ruff` / `black` interplay. Can someone quick-triage?

ci-bot: Failure summary for run 4825 on 1722223333:
• job: precommit (linux) — FAILED
• errors: mypy (1 error), ruff (formatting), black (diff)
• failing files: `server/kvcache/__init__.py`, `tools/cli/arg_parsing.py`

maks: I can take a look. Do we have the exact mypy output? quick paste would help.

elaine: Paste below (from the job):
```
server/kvcache/__init__.py:42: error: Incompatible return value type (got "Optional[bytes]", expected "bytes")  [return-value]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 123 source files)
```
Also ruff flagged an f-string that grew too long in `arg_parsing.py` — easy to fix but want to understand the mypy one first.

sri: That mypy error smells like a signature change upstream — maybe a helper now returns Optional. Was there a recent change to `kvcache.get_raw`?

ryan: I looked at the commit log: yesterday @maria bumped a dependency and one of our small helpers got an Optional in the chain. Quick bisect approach: try the last 3 merges touching `kvcache` and the `types` stubs.

maks: I'm running a local mypy with the same constraints (pyproject toml / pinned mypy.ini). Will repro and try a quick patch to narrow whether it's a regression in our code or a stricter mypy rule.

ops-bot: Rerun request queued: precommit (linux) — id 4825.queued_by=maks scheduled_in=30s

(1m later)

maks: Reproduced locally. The helper `read_blob` was changed to return `Optional[bytes]` in commit 1722199000 (author: mariab). The call site in `kvcache.__init__` didn't handle None. Easy fix: add an explicit check and a typed fallback or tighten the helper return.

elaine: Ok, plan: 1) quick PR to handle None guard in `kvcache` (small), 2) separate PR to update types/tests if we prefer the helper to always return bytes. Who can pick the quick patch?

ryan: I'll open the fix PR and mark it as hotfix -> base `main`. Will ping for review.

maks: For the ruff/black issue in `arg_parsing.py`, it's just a formatting wrap — I'll push that as part of the same hotfix branch to avoid another CI roundtrip.

ci-bot: Rerun started: precommit (linux) — run_id=4825.1 triggered_by=ops-bot

elaine: Thanks all — if the hotfix lands and CI passes, we'll fast-track the dependent PR. If it still fails after the hotfix, we'll do a targeted bisect across the last 5 merges touching `types` and `kvcache`.

maks: quick note for reviewers: I'll include the failing mypy snippet in the PR description and add `#ci-skip` to any unrelated commits in the hotfix branch.

ops-bot: Rerun completed: precommit (linux) — SUCCESS ✅

elaine: :tada: great. Ryan — open the PR and add `squash` label. I'll do the final review after lunch.

ryan: PR opened: https://git.example.com/redwood/repo/pull/4832 — includes None-guard + formatting. Tagging @elaine @maks for quick review. :shipit:
